m: रट् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. ix, 10) रटति (pf. रराट; fut. रटिता &c. Gr.), to howl, shout, roar, yell, cry, Kāv.; Var.; Kathās.; to crash (as an axe), Prab.; to ring (as a bell), Mālatīm.; to lament, wail, HPariś.; to proclaim aloud, Kṛṣṇaj. : Caus. रटयति (aor. अरीरटत्), to howl, shout &c., Daś. : Intens. रारटीति, to scream aloud, roar, yell, caw &c., R., KāśīKh.; Bhojapr.
a: रट् — {c1c} P. (रटति, रटित) 1 To shout, scream, yell, cry, roar, howl; घोराश्चारटिषुः शिवाः Bk. 15. 27; पपात राक्षसो भूमौ रराट च भयंकरं 14. 81. --2 To call out, proclaim loudly. --3 To shout with joy, applaud.

s: vAci । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) rawati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: BAzaRe BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । rawati arAwIt arawIt rewatuH “mAGe mAsi rawantyApaH” mala॰ ta॰ ।

a: रटंती — N. of the fourteenth day in the dark half of Māgha.

m: रटन n. shouting, shout, applause, Rājat.
a: रटनं — [रट् ल्युट्] 1 The act of crying, screaming or shouting. --2 A shout of applause, approbation.

s: strI, (rawyate puRyajanakatvena kaTyate iti । raw + bahulakAt Jac । NIp .) gORacAndramAGIyakfzRacaturddaSI । tatra aruRodayakAle snAnaM karttavyam । yaTA । yamaH । “mAGe mAsyasite pakze rawantyAKyA caturddaSI । tasyAmudayavelAyAM snAtA nAvekzate yamam ॥” udayavelAyAmaruRodayavelAyAm । “anarkAByudite kAle mAGe kfzRacaturddaSI । satAravyomakAle tu tatra snAnaM mahAPalam । snAtvA santarpya tu yamAn sarvvapApEH pramucyate ॥” atra tiTikftyatvAt gORacAndrAdaraH । atrAruRodayakAla eva snAnaM pUrvvoktacaturddaSayamatarpaRaYca । yattu udayavelAyAM sUryyodayavelAyAM anarkAByudita iti IzadarTe naYiti vyAKyAnaM tat samudrakaraBAzyaDftasatAravyoma iti ityuttarArdDAnavalokaneneti । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ kiYca । “anarkAByudite kAle snAnaM kuryyAt sarijjale । SatajanmakftaM pApaM tatkzaRAdeva naSyati ॥ rawantI nAma viKyAtA sarvvapApaharA SivA ॥” iti matsyasUkte 55 pawalaH ॥ kvacit pustake sarijjale ityatra vahirjjale iti pAWaH ॥ * ॥ tatra SyAmApUjAviDiryaTA, -- “mAGe mAsyasite pakze rawantyAKyA caturddaSI । tasyAM saMpUjayettArAM mahAviBavavistarEH । cakravarttI mahArAjo Bavatyeva na saMSayaH ॥” iti bfhannIlatantre 7 pawalaH ॥ api ca । “mAGe mAsyasite pakze rawantyAKyA caturddaSI । tadrAtrO kAlikApUjA sarvvaviGnopaSAntaye ॥” iti kAlikApurARam ॥ * ॥ aparaYca । “mAGe mAsyasite pakze rawantyAKyA caturddaSI । tasyAM pradozasamaye pUjayenmuRqamAlinIm ॥” ityAcAryyacUqAmaRikftakftyatattvArRavaDftavacanam ॥ anyat SyAmASabde drazwavyam ॥
v: strI rawa--bA॰ JaS NIp । “mAGe mAsyasite pakze rawantyAKyA caturddaSI । tasyAM pradozasamaye pUjayet muRqaH mAlinIm” ityuktAyAM mAGakfzRacaturdaSyAm ।
m: रटन्ती f. N. of the 14th day in the dark half of the month Māgha, W.

s: tri, kaTitam । rawaDAtoH karmmaRi ktapratyayena nizpannam । (BAve ktaH .) kaTanamAtre, klI ॥ (yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm । 2 । 174 । “vanaharirasitEH pade pade sa pratiBawatAM pawahaDvanerddaDAnEH । amanuta rawitESca karkarewoH parigalitAM gamanontuKastriyAmAm ॥”)
m: रटित n. shouting, roaring, yelling, screaming, creaking, crying, Kād.; Hcar.; Rājat.
a: रटितं — A scream, shout, yell, cry; Mu. 1. 21.

m: रट्टा f. N. of a princess, Rājat.
